interpretation: Positive mixed_over_native_pct means slower. Primary native/repaired/mixed all use one CUDA Graph. Two-graph lanes isolate host submission count; mixed prepacked is an auxiliary lower bound. Native means original operator kernels, not the full serving baseline.
repair_cost_note: Marlin repair selects full-K/non-atomic/block-M8 together. This is total repaired arithmetic cost, not an isolated atomic-instruction experiment.
caveats: The RTX4060 Laptop result does not establish A100 speedup or complete-model throughput/TTFT/TPOT.
Bundles contain real projections, shared-expert gate/activation, live native TopK and AWQ experts, but no Attention/GDN recurrence, cache commit, residual/norm or logits.
Bundle execution is serial router -> routed experts -> shared expert -> projection bundle; it is not a faithful transformer-layer timeline and does not overlap the shared expert on another stream.
Profile hot32 is an explicit synthetic router-logit bias, not observed checkpoint routing.
The isolated expert operator freezes routes across all lanes. Its padding IDs/scores are zero sentinels; padding conclusions should use the live-router bundles.
Packing occurs at these operator boundaries; it is not a measurement of complete-model graph metadata/packing overhead.
Static weights/inputs replayed after warmup; no full serving memory pressure or input refresh. p95 is the distribution of trial means, not output-gap p95.
Near-zero changes are inconclusive; laptop clocks/power and cross-row input routing differ. Compare the three lanes within each row.
